events.description: Fired when a round concludes.  Carries the winning team (`winner`), the reason for the win (`reason`, see RoundEndReason table below), and a human-readable `message` string.
events.name: round_end
events.notes: The `winner` value uses the same team-number scheme as the `Team` constant in `well_known_constants.json` (2=T, 3=CT, 0/1 for draw / unassigned).  The `reason` byte enumerates win conditions: bomb detonation, defusal, time expiry, eliminations, surrender, etc. — full mapping is in `public/cstrike15_gameconstants.h` upstream.
